basic_info.description: Welcome to 3055A Clay Street, a secluded garden apartment right in the heart of prime Pacific Heights surrounded by luxury homes. This place offers 720 square feet of space that's all about privacy. With its southern exposure, you'll enjoy tons of natural light, making the place feel bright and inviting. Step out to a brick patio, perfect for kicking back or having friends over. Living here gives you a peaceful vibe while still being in the middle of everything. If you're after a modern pad with a touch of charm in one of SF's top neighborhoods, this is it. Come by and see why this place is so special!
